I'm sorry to hear the item arrived damaged. Order 1005 is still marked as pending, not paid, so I can't submit a refund for it. Refunds are only available for paid orders.

If you believe your payment went through, please check that first, and I can look at the order again. If the item is damaged and the order is later marked as paid, you can ask again. I can also send your case to a human reviewer if you'd like.
